confirmedValueChanges.displayNameBasis: Selector GUID f66c9ab7-bb18-4d2d-8133-6d90b19f0e84 in the GS_ assets binds this modifier to WPM_SCP_ElcanDR. The only 1-4x LPVO string in fs_us_loc is 1582DFEB, SU-230 LPVO. The AD_ metadata does not carry the string id directly, so the link is by selector and designation, not by a decoded name reference.
confirmedValueChanges.reading: Superseded first-pass zoom assignment: the camera-recoil ladder identifies the changed member as the 1x state, not 4x. Its paired field was already -0.5; the 4x state holds 0.505185. This is structural consistency evidence, not an independently decoded unit or runtime formula. See the SDK-independent decode provenance for the ladder.
confirmedValueChanges.alsoChanged: Field_36c2f877 Field_bbbfe9cc moved -0.5 to 0 while its flag was already False, so it is inert.

confirmedValueChanges.reading: Not muzzle velocity. Struct_cb53a662 is a generic three-member struct reused throughout Class_76a3b0eb, a per-zoom-level view block that references a VE_ view entity, here VE_IronSights, the M320 own sight. Field_32a99b9c is only the third member. A survey of all Common/Hardware/Weapons XML found 222 occurrences of this field: 90 are 0,0,0 and 64 are already 0,0,-99.8. The new value is the common existing setting, so this reads as the M320 view block adopting the standard value, not a balance change.
confirmedValueChanges.supersedes: An earlier note in the first-pass 1.4.3.0 report called this an initial-speed modifier. That was wrong.

attachmentBugRecheck.method: Compared the 1.4.3.0 changed-asset set against the assets behind each entry in docs/ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md.
attachmentBugRecheck.result: No source asset behind bugs 1 to 10 changed. Only three GS_ assets changed in the whole build (GS_VSSM, GS_RagingHunter, GS_TRR8) and none belongs to a listed bug. The only changed Attachment_ asset is the Interdictor iron sights point cost.
attachmentBugRecheck.limit: Superseded on 2026-09-16: SDK-independent reference comparison and direct old/new localization lookup support unchanged recorded wording. No new live-panel captures or complete rerun of every attachment recheck were established.
